biotools.summary: CWAS-Plus is a software resource that estimates category-wide association of rare noncoding variation from whole-genome sequencing data by integrating user-provided functional data. It facilitates the identification of noncoding variant associations in genomic disorders and enables scalability for processing large-scale whole-genome sequencing data.
